proposed_manuscript_prose: Across three Instacart validation fits per architecture, CNN+GRU54 achieved the lowest mean overall quantity RMSE (5.87737 ± 0.00950), compared with 5.88540 ± 0.01346 for MLP8 and 5.88006 ± 0.01692 for MLP12. Each fit contributed all six metrics from its earliest finite minimum-RMSE checkpoint, and the reported dispersions are sample standard deviations across seeds.

Quantity improvements were consistent against MLP8, whereas the seed-52 CNN fit incurred higher overall and large-quantity RMSE than MLP12. Although CNN+GRU54 reduced large-quantity TimeNLL in all six paired comparisons, its mean overall TimeNLL increased to 2.81080, compared with 2.80748 for MLP8 and 2.80721 for MLP12. The largest time-score losses occurred at seed 62.

These comparisons are restricted to the original validation population and do not constitute an independent evaluation. The three architectures differ in total trainable parameters (89,859 for MLP8, 96,003 for MLP12, and 102,879 for CNN+GRU54), while the same-seed fits share their assigned GPU and runtime. The Instacart comparison alone does not establish the Q1 or Q2 contribution claims.
